Good, and still run node bash/face-owner.js <face key> on your box. Being a contact is only one of its three jobs. It also writes face-domain.json and grants 'join' to your node, and without those your node answers the face 'no such route', and Caddy gets no certificate. Its contact steps are harmless when already done, and if your node has the face HELD rather than accepted, which is the default for a stranger, it accepts it.
